summary: The implementation architecture now freezes remote AI4X HTTP MCP registration as the canonical AI4X boundary, keeps existing explicit testcase entry paths read-only, downgrades the local CLI bridge to transitional support, and hands four MCP-readiness failures to Coding/Repair.

explicitEntrypoints.testcaseName: OPENCODE workspace MCP registration and transitional dependencies
explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Execute the existing pytest entrypoint and load both agent_app/opencode_app/.opencode/opencode.json and agent_app/opencode_app/.opencode/workspace.contract.json.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The test asserts that the canonical ai4x MCP registration exists and that transitional local runtime files still exist as migration support.

explicitEntrypoints.testcaseName: 发现AI4X-Platform上可以提供的数据范围
explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Execute the pytest entrypoint, load the registered AI4X MCP server from opencode.json, probe /mcp/healthz, initialize MCP, verify tools/list contains ai4x_query, then call ai4x_query command=catalog.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The observable output is either a valid catalog payload with databases[] and total_databases or a direct MCP readiness failure emitted by _require_registered_ai4x_mcp_environment.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Registered AI4X MCP health probe is not ready at http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp/healthz: timed out

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Execute the pytest entrypoint, require MCP readiness, call ai4x_query command=catalog through MCP to choose a source_id, then call ai4x_query command=query through MCP.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The observable output is either a query payload with source_id, items, and count or a direct MCP readiness failure emitted before tools/call query starts.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Registered AI4X MCP health probe is not ready at http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp/healthz: timed out

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Execute the pytest entrypoint, require MCP readiness, call ai4x_query schema(opencti) through MCP, derive one detail pointer, then call ai4x_query detail for that pointer.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The observable output is either an OpenCTI detail payload that matches the platform detail view or a direct MCP readiness failure emitted before schema/detail calls.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Registered AI4X MCP health probe is not ready at http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp/healthz: timed out

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Execute the pytest entrypoint, require the registered MCP boundary to be reachable, then drive ThreatIntelListener.process_event with data/mock_events/mock_opencti_push_event.json and a mock remote server.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The observable output is either a structured listener result whose ai4x evidence records transport=remote_http_mcp and mcp_server metadata or a direct MCP readiness failure emitted before listener observation begins.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Registered AI4X MCP health probe is not ready at http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp/healthz: timed out

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: Workspace MCP registration boundary
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read opencode.json and workspace.contract.json and compare the ai4x MCP server registration fields.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The guard asserts transport=http, url ending in /mcp, healthz ending in /mcp/healthz, and tool surface=[ai4x_query].

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: Explicit tests target MCP boundary
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read tests/test_ai4x_platform_integration.py and isolate the four explicit AI4X acceptance sections.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The guard asserts those sections do not call the local JS/Python wrapper directly and instead call MCP helper functions.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: Explicit entry path correctness
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read the explicit test files at their canonical repository paths.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The guard asserts the canonical function entrypoints still exist at the frozen paths, including the progressive-disclosure test.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: Architecture traceability tags
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The guard asserts the ArchitectureID tags remain bound to the canonical entry files.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: Local bridge compatibility surface
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read the isolated runtime file layout under agent_app/opencode_app.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The guard asserts the local compatibility bridge still exists and has no duplicate root-level runtime files.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: Real OPENCODE ai4x_query activity
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Drive a real OPENCODE session and inspect ai4x_query tool activity.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The test is allowed to evolve during Coding/Repair while preserving the frozen explicit entrypoints.

openGaps: The registered MCP endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp/healthz timed out during the initial explicit execution run.
ThreatIntelListener evidence output has not yet been proven to record transport=remote_http_mcp and mcp_server metadata.
The local ai4x_query_local.js -> tools.ai4x_cli compatibility bridge still exists and may continue to surface analyst-only behavior until Coding/Repair removes or relocates that drift.
No implementation-side proof has yet shown that the real OPENCODE runtime consumes the MCP registration from opencode.json rather than the deprecated local wrapper path.
